notes: WArmy 0.4.23 — mimic touch & right-click menu round (3 items): old WArmyData backups are deleted and the acceptance flow no longer keeps backups (owner decision); double-clicking the transformed mimic NO LONGER opens the chat window — a double click is simply two pats, and holding the mouse down (continuous petting, with duration) or holding and dragging from one spot to another (stroke with start/end coordinates) are all reported to the model via an interaction queue that survives the anti-spam throttle; right-clicking the mimic now does nothing on press, holding and dragging rotates the 3D form, and releasing WITHOUT having rotated opens a menu with exactly five entries — Dialog on/off (the subtitle bubble switch, now actually effective), Hide, Window (the mimic independent chat window), Voice-interaction mode (off/wake/always/smart radio submenu) and Settings (main UI Settings > Mimic); the menu is rendered inside the mimic window (native menus cannot take keyboard focus on a focusable:false transparent window) with a union body-rect so it stays clickable, ESC/outside-click/auto-close dismiss it, and every touch/menu action lands in the audit log. 5 new UI strings across all 27 locales. Verified by a 34-assertion real-machine probe (independent launch per case: tap/double-tap/hold/stroke semantics, menu open/ESC, all five menu actions with settings/window facts, 2D/3D rotation suppressing the menu) plus the scoped suite: 15 gates x 3 consecutive clean rounds covering exactly the changed surfaces plus R224-R227 contract regressions.
